label: At most one actual being is its own esse, from De ente's multiplication inventory
description: Stage (b) of De ente c.3 [69874] (Baur/Koch; Leonine c.4), non-transcription conditional derivation on the q.3 a.4 profile: at most one being in act has its represented esse equal to its essence. The source supplies the multiplication inventory and the exclusion of an added difference and of matter; the third mode (one absolute, another received) is excluded through three existing open reception premises; the indispensable analyst premise is that two such beings would share one nature (the #697 individuation gap), which TwoSourcesControl omits. Only 'at most one' follows: no such being is said to exist.
